parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 20.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID where the service instance resides.

parameters.name: ServiceInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the service instance.

parameters.name: ServiceInstanceResourceType
parameters.description: Service Instance resource type，include AliyunResource and ContainerResource.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenestsupplier list-service-instance-resources --next-token AAAAAc3HCuYhJi/wvpk4xOr0VLbAx7BkQzyYC+ONO+WudHGKEdB0uWSY7AGnM3qCgm/Ynge7zU6NWdbj0Tegyajyqyc= --max-results 20 --service-instance-id si-d8a0cc2a1ee04dce0000 --tag Value=value1 Key=key1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-instance-resource-type AliyunResource --filters '[{"Values":["arn:acs:ecs:0:0:instance/0"],"Name":"ResourceARN"}]' --region cn-hangzhou
